units.source_text: 他这一番关心日本舞蹈的谈话，之所以有助于促使她去亲近他，应该说这是由于他的这些知识在事隔多年之后，又在现实中起了作用。

en.t: The reason his conversation showing such interest in Japanese dance helped draw her closer to him was, one might say, that after so many years his knowledge had once again proved useful in real life.

units.source_text: 可说不定还是岛村在不知不觉中把她当作了西方舞蹈呢。

en.t: But perhaps Shimamura had, without realizing it, still treated her as though she were Western dance.
